Commissions and Fees
How pricing works on Lizimas
When you add a product, you enter the amount you want to be paid — Lizimas works out the customer-facing price from that, never the other way around. Marketplace charges are already built into that calculation, so the payout you set is exactly what lands in your Wallet once an order is delivered.
Where to see the numbers
Every order shows its Sale amount, Marketplace charges, and Net payable in your Wallet and on Home — always in UGX, never as a percentage. Rates vary by product category and are set by Lizimas; if you'd like the specifics for a category you sell in, reach out from Give us your feedback in the Menu.
Holiday Mode
Schedule Holiday Mode
Turning on Holiday Mode temporarily delists all of your active products from Lizimas Store, so customers can't place new orders with you while you're away. Orders already placed before Holiday Mode starts still need to be fulfilled as normal. Your shop and products come back automatically on the end date you choose.
Holiday Mode is currently On
Choose a start and end date to turn on Holiday Mode.

Orders

Move each item through New → Accepted → Processing → Ready for Handover, then prepare it per the Packaging Guidelines and Fulfilment Guidelines and mark it handed over. Lizimas Store inspects each item before accepting it and taking over delivery.

Loading...

Returns Awaiting Collection

Failed deliveries and customer returns come back here. Collect within 7 days from the original drop-off point, or within 21 days total once moved to the central hub — after that the item may be forfeited.

Loading...

Returns & Refunds

Why an item came back, any evidence photo Lizimas attached, Lizimas' refund decision, and the recorded amount. This is separate from the Returns tab, which is only about physically collecting the item back. Lizimas makes the final call on every refund - you can add your own response below any return.
